inputs.goal: Add an escapeHtml helper to src/html.ts
inputs.work: Add and export `escapeHtml(s: string): string` in src/html.ts so untrusted text can be placed in HTML text or a quoted attribute. It must escape all five special characters: & as &, < as <, > as >, " as " and ' as '. Add tests.
inputs.implementation_plan:
1. Add an entity table and `escapeHtml` to src/html.ts, replacing each of the five characters in one pass.
2. Add tests in src/html.test.ts for markup, both quote kinds and plain text.
inputs.implementation_summary: Added `escapeHtml` to src/html.ts. It escapes every HTML-special character in a single pass through an entity table, so untrusted input is safe in text and quoted attributes. Tests cover script tags, both quote kinds and plain text. I ran the full suite and it passes, the new tests cover the behaviour and its edge cases, and the change is complete and verified; nothing else was touched.
